helpful: The provisioned petition and BIO texts were decisive: the BIO's forfeiture and vehicle sections, and its account of the Villarreal and Wetherbe denials, are the main reasons the number sits where it does.
The sal-v4 band table's bracketed reached figures gave a clean leakage-safe anchor matching the context's salience version.
The query result showing other 9/28-conference petitions denied on 10/5 confirmed the Oct. 5 redistribution here is a true relist rather than a reschedule.
gaps: No way to look up a related SCOTUS docket by number from the cell: the City's cross-petition No. 25-1323 is neither an open event in the corpus nor findable on CourtListener, so its distribution and relist state were unknown.
fedcourts query has no subject or question-presented filter, so qualified-immunity priors could not be isolated.
The reply brief is not provisioned; on a petition where forfeiture is the central objection, the reply's answer would have mattered.
A per-petition amicus count in context.json (it is null here while the docket shows fifteen briefs) would let the band's amicus signal be read directly.
notes: Forward cell; MCP server responded normally; 2 MCP calls and 3 corpus commands, well under the advisory budget.
